ei.title: 3번 — 사회적 수용과 개인적 인정을 향한 인간의 모순된 욕구
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본2

fullPassage: We all desire to feel that we are 'normal,' that we fit in and are accepted by others, that we are one of the crowd. Put another way, we generally avoid being regarded as 'being difficult to deal with' or 'not being part of the crowd.' That is, we don't want to appear odd, strange, or anti-social in any way. It may be true that a few eccentrics might deliberately cultivate personal idiosyncracies in order to attract attention, but generally their ultimate goal is to be accepted (even if only by a small collection of admirers) and not regarded as complete social outcasts. However, while the yearning to be accepted and to belong is strong, we strain equally towards being recognized as individuals, and to being thought of as personally significant. Even if in only a minor sense, we wish to stand out from the crowd and not merely blend in with it. We would like our unique contributions to be acknowledged and we want our identities to be honoured as having some special significance in the world. We want to be visible and believed in. We don't want to be overlooked or ignored, as if we weren't there. It's not that we necessarily wish to be famous, or some kind of celebrity (although apparently, many of us wish to be), it's more that we want to avoid invisibility. In no matter how small a way, and to no matter how few people, we want to feel just a little bit special.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② attracting → to attract: 'in order to + 동사원형'(~하기 위해) 목적 구문이므로 to attract가 맞다. attracting(동명사/분사)은 형태가 어긋나 틀림.

❌ ① to feel: 'We all desire to feel that ~'에서 desire의 목적어로 쓰인 to부정사. 정상

✅ ② attracting(오류) → to attract: 'in order to attract attention'은 '관심을 끌기 위해'라는 목적을 나타내는 「in order to + 동사원형」 구문. attracting(동명사/분사)은 틀림 ← 정답

❌ ③ to be acknowledged: 'would like our unique contributions to be acknowledged'에서 「would like + 목적어 + to부정사」. 정상

❌ ④ ignored: 'overlooked or ignored'는 be동사 뒤 과거분사의 병렬. 정상
det.tip: 「in order to + 동사원형」 = ~하기 위해(목적). 뒤에 -ing를 쓰지 않는다.

questions.passage: We all desire to feel that we are 'normal,' that we fit in and are accepted by others, that we are one of the crowd. Put another way, we generally avoid being regarded as 'being difficult to deal with' or 'not being part of the crowd.' That is, we don't want to appear odd, strange, or anti-social in any way. It may be true that a few eccentrics might deliberately cultivate personal idiosyncracies in order to attract attention, but generally their ultimate goal is to be accepted (even if only by a small collection of admirers) and not regarded as complete social outcasts. However, while __________, we strain equally towards being recognized as individuals, and to being thought of as personally significant. Even if in only a minor sense, we wish to stand out from the crowd and not merely blend in with it. We would like our unique contributions to be acknowledged and we want our identities to be honoured as having some special significance in the world. We want to be visible and believed in. We don't want to be overlooked or ignored, as if we weren't there. It's not that we necessarily wish to be famous, or some kind of celebrity (although apparently, many of us wish to be), it's more that we want to avoid invisibility. In no matter how small a way, and to no matter how few people, we want to feel just a little bit special.
